literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe a single construct: YFP fused to the intracellular N-terminus of full-length, membrane-anchored dog Na,K-ATPase β1 (ATP1B1). The topology landmarks place residues 1–35 in the cytoplasm (INTRACELLULAR: 1–35), the TM helix at 36–56, and the entire large ectodomain at 57–303. The YFP fusion is therefore on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any insertion in the extracellular domain (residues 57–303) or at the extracellular C-terminus (residue 303). The ledger supports zero surface tag sites.

literature_other_positions.note: YFP fused to the intracellular N-terminus of full-length membrane-anchored ATP1B1; residues 1–35 are cytoplasmic per topology landmarks, so this is a cytoplasmic label, not a surface tag.
